content: Google music-synthesizer-for-android Dx7Envelope wiki (the reference implementation Dexed's engine derives from): envelope indexes 4 segments 0-3 (L1..L4/R1..R4); on reaching a segment's target level the index advances to the next segment; rate 0-99 maps to a quantized qrate = (rate*41)/64; decay speed ~= 0.2819 * 2^(qrate/4) * (1 + 0.25*(qrate mod 4)) dB/s (each 4 qrate steps doubles speed); attack rate is the decay-rate value scaled by a level-dependent factor 2+floor((full_scale-current_level)/256), with attack's initial jump to ~40dB above minimum for a crisper onset. This is a widely-cited, non-official but authoritative reverse-engineering source used by production-quality open-source DX7 emulators.
